originalCorpora.countingRule: Original12 core,5 builtCLI,4 separation and10 read-only verifier are four separate invocations. The31 file/title registrations are their union, not one combined31-case run or new causal executions.

runtime.boundary: Fresh owned source-install native load and in-memory query. No shared native rebuild, product model call, OS isolation or per-other-child ABI inference.

trustAndLifecycleMeaning.core12: Owned workspace/real encrypted blob writer and ledger verifier, then tamper/plans/apply snapshots. Hold verdict callbacks and receipt SignedDigest signer are injected; receipt signatures are stub strings. fs is an existing plain-object mock for rename spying. Writer/pools are closed before repair; no active-writer race.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.builtCLI5: Actual built dist/cli.js children through the unchanged helper; expected exit0/1/2 results, plan/no-confirmation/receipt/archive-note behavior and one edited-monitor failure message. Local real REPAIR_RECEIPT signature verification and altered-byte refusal are assertions in the passing source case. Inherited environment, per-call AMC_HOME/passphrase and original60s child timeout remain. No independent external issuer/trust anchor, separate child transcript/PID record or active-writer claim.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.separation4: Evidence-chain versus config-governance cases using owned local keys/workspaces, one invalid config signature, a valid signed-event baseline and a deliberate fixture DB metadata rewrite after dropping its immutability trigger. This is verifier/governance sensitivity in local fixtures.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.readOnly10: Two cold-process vault-format positives plus four cold-process encrypted-evidence refusal cases; four further original in-process cases cover public-only key preservation/no vault, JSONL signed-row tamper/no SQLite creation, missing JSONL log and missing ledger. Disk-state comparison checks SHA/mtime/mode while excluding SQLite WAL/SHM. Six cold Node/tsx calls are in the original passing case paths; per-child PID/stdout evidence is not separately retained. Local fixture keys are not independent external authority.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.lifecycle: Four observed outer Vitest groups closed with actual retained signal-zero ESRCH after exit0. Run-end observer is before global teardown; full streams/exit/group records supplement it. This is not universal descendant absence, whole-filesystem nonmutation or complete teardown proof.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.environment: Original launch environment is inherited with private HOME, Node22 PATH and explicit reporter output/GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH overrides. It is not a credential-free allowlist or operating-system/network sandbox.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.sourceVersusBuilt: Core12 imports original TS source via normal Vitest source resolution. CLI5 runs the built entrypoint. Future TS-only controls over core12 cannot claim compiled CLI sensitivity while dist remains unchanged.
trustAndLifecycleMeaning.futureBoundary: These four passing original corpora are a necessary baseline only. Root's remaining normal guards, separate complete causal preparation/static review and exact release must finish before causal execution. C1/C2 are still unexecuted recipes; no mutation result or full formal acceptance is supplied.

recipe.title: Remove unknown and active legal-hold refusals as one current admission control

anchors.find: if (hold.state === "unknown") throw new RepairRefused(`legal hold state unknown: ${hold.reason}`);
if (hold.state === "active") throw new RepairRefused(`legal hold active: ${hold.holdIds.join(", ")}`);

recipe.meaning: Potential fail-closed admission sensitivity under injected legalHolds callbacks and a stub signer. Source permits proceeding after callback unknown/active when both refusals are removed; original case bodies may stop before all state assertions. The returned receipt uses literal legalHold.state none at source:208, but these original failed cases do not independently retain/assert that receipt.
